title: Asia Democracy Foundation 民主亞洲基金會(美國紐約)
content_html: The Asia Democracy Foundation is dedicated to promoting democratization in Asia, with a particular focus on China. Operating through modern internet and email platforms, the foundation publishes the online journal ‘Democracy Forum’ and the electronic newsletter ‘Democracy Newsletter.’ It has built a global network of individuals concerned with Chinese democratization and human rights issues, with readers and contributors reaching deep into mainland China. The foundation serves as a bridge for the exchange of experiences between the Taiwanese democratic movement and democratic movements in mainland China.
